units.source_text: 对于我来说，美总是姗姗来迟，比别人来迟。

en.t: For me, beauty always arrived late, later than it did for other people.

units.source_text: 别人同时发现美和官能，我却迟迟才发现它们。

en.t: Others discovered beauty and sensuality at the same time, but I only found them much later.

units.source_text: 眼看着乳房恢复了与全体的联系……

en.t: Watching as the breasts regained their connection with the whole...

units.source_text: 变成无快感的却是不朽的物质，变成与永恒联系的东西。

en.t: They became a pleasureless yet immortal substance, something joined to eternity.
